import hashlib,json,pathlib,re
r=pathlib.Path("projects/rapid-fire-prototype/playable")
names=["Config","PairCore","Controls","Demo","IntegratedTest","Log","MapMain","TestMapMain"]
s={n:(r/"src"/(n+".j")).read_text() for n in names}
checks={}
checks["all-eight-sources-utf8-no-bom"]=all(not t.startswith("\ufeff") for t in s.values())
checks["balanced-function-blocks"]=all(len(re.findall(r"(?m)^\s*(?:private )?function ",t))==len(re.findall(r"(?m)^\s*endfunction\b",t)) for t in s.values())
checks["balanced-method-blocks"]=all(len(re.findall(r"(?m)^\s*(?:private )?(?:static )?method ",t))==len(re.findall(r"(?m)^\s*endmethod\b",t)) for t in s.values())
checks["no-modern-userdata-exit-or-nested-imports"]=not any(re.search(r"\b(?:Blz\w*|FourCC|SetUnitUserData|ExitProcess|EndGame)\s*\(|^\s*//!\s*import",t,re.M) for t in s.values())
checks["shown-unpaused-controller"]=not any(re.search(r"call\s+(?:ShowUnit|PauseUnit)\((?:actor|visible|logical|controller)",t) for t in s.values())
c=s["PairCore"]
checks["actual-terrain-and-world-dispatch"]=all(x in c for x in ["method onTerrain takes nothing returns boolean","method onBoundaries takes nothing returns boolean"]) and "method onCliff" not in c
step=c[c.index("private function OnMove "):c.index("private function ResumeNative ")]
checks["no-per-step-facing-animation-or-orders"]=not any(x in step[step.index("if not goal then"):] for x in ["SetUnitFacing","SetUnitAnimation","IssuePointOrder","IssueImmediateOrder"])
checks["single-order-dispatch-condition"]=c.count("TriggerAddCondition(orderHook,")==1 and "function OnOrder" in c
checks["legacy-abi-preserved"]=all("function "+n+" takes" in c for n in ["RB_GetShotMissile","RB_GetShotSource","RB_GetShotX","RB_GetShotY","RB_InitializePair","RB_Dispose"])
main=lambda t:t[t.index("function main takes"):]
checks["identical-world-main"]=main(s["MapMain"])==main(s["TestMapMain"])
checks["integrated-run-id"]= "rfp-integrated-20261020-01" in s["Log"] and "RF-rfp-integrated-20261020-01.txt" in s["Log"]
for name,entry in [("test01","RF_StartIntegratedTest"),("playable01","RF_StartDemo")]:
 p=json.loads((r/("build-plan-"+name+".json")).read_text());a=p["argv"]
 checks["plan-"+name+"-entry"]=a[a.index("--entry")+1]==entry
 checks["plan-"+name+"-pending-base-pin"]=p["base_sha256"] is None
 if name=="playable01": checks["playable-excludes-battery"]=not any("IntegratedTest.j" in v or "Log.j" in v for v in a)
seed=pathlib.Path("projects/rapid-fire-prototype/src/prototype/PairCore.j")
checks["preserved-tested-Core6442"]=hashlib.sha256(seed.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=="6442b4b2afbaa48c3090789ed63e934938039e1c459c3944bcf89568fc1ce923"
print(json.dumps({"checks":checks,"source_lines":{n:len(t.splitlines()) for n,t in s.items()},"external_call_inventory":sorted(set(re.findall(r"\bcall\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\(","\n".join(s.values())))-set(re.findall(r"\bfunction\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s+takes","\n".join(s.values()))))},sort_keys=True))
raise SystemExit(not all(checks.values()))
